issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: oxeye_daisy, azure_bluet, cornflower, green_carpet, cartography_table, lectern, bookshelf, light_blue_stained_glass, candle, red_wall_banner.
469 blocks, over the common budget of 350 (docs/STRUCTURES.md). A warning only.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.levels: L3 adds mostly props: carpets, a map table, a bench at the back, a lantern post, bushes and flowers. Nice, but no clearly visible new feature or job; from outside it is hard to tell from L2.
notes.detail: Capped at 1 because L3 adds no clearly visible new feature over L2 (Carlton rule).
notes.roof: Steep 45-degree roof with one block of overhang on all four sides (eaves at x1/x9, z0/z10), dark oak eaves and ridge stripe: the automatic overhang warning is a false alarm.
notes.life: Bushes, flowers, lantern post and vines round the base.

visual.summary: Adds carpets, a globe and map table, a back bench, flowers, bushes, vines and a lantern post; the building itself is the same as L2.
problems: L3 looks almost the same as L2 from outside: add one clearly visible new feature, e.g. a small reading porch or lean-to, a dormer/oriel window on a side, or a fenced reading garden with benches.
Reach: the whole hall floor is reached; only roof slopes, bookshelf tops and stair tops are unreached - fine.
